verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries (granola-docs-16, granola-docs-33). The docs also describe API keys: workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can create workspace keys, and the word "also" implies individual user keys exist (granola-docs-28). Missing for 10: action items are never named as an API field, personal self-serve keys are only implied, the docs describe workspace keys only for Business/Enterprise plans, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
